home.title: Welcome
body: Browse the main tools for students, squads, timelines, and calculators.
Use each card to jump directly to the feature you need.

students.title: Student data list
body: Review and sort your saved student stats. Use filters or grid switches to focus on specific roles or attributes.
Register new students or update local data before syncing.

students-import.title: Student OCR import
body: Upload screenshots to extract student stats with OCR.
Open this help panel for tips on improving accuracy and speed.

student-detail.title: Student details
body: Check detailed stats, skills, and equipment for a single student.
Use this page as the source of truth when comparing builds.

squads.title: Squad management
body: Create and edit squads with strikers and specials.
Share squads with others or copy existing shared squads into your list.

tl-maker.title: TL maker
body: Build or import timelines, then adjust skills, markers, and squads.
Use the controls to manage timeline length, skill colors, and templates.

tl-maker-dev.title: TL maker (dev)
body: Try experimental TL features such as free layout and plugins.
Features may change frequently—use with caution for production timelines.

tl-search.title: TL search
body: Search published timelines by boss, armor, terrain, or season.
Open a TL to view details or copy it to your own workspace.

tl-update.title: TL import
body: Fetch timeline data for a selected season and save it locally.
Use this to update your workspace with the newest shared TLs.

tl-damage.title: Damage calculator
body: Estimate expected damage for squads and skills under different conditions.
Adjust stats to compare builds and share results.

settings.title: Settings
body: Switch between light and dark mode.
Clear cached data such as student records, TL caches, and notice states.

mypage.title: User settings
body: Edit your profile information and linked services.
Manage your Tools ID, nickname, and visibility preferences.

tools-divine-calc.title: Kivotos insights calculator
body: Estimate Kivotos Insights (神名文字) needs and expected returns.
Use rate-adjusted results to plan pulls and farming.

tools-bond-calc.title: Bond calculator
body: Calculate required items to reach your target bond level.
Simulate different item mixes to minimize overuse.

tools-event-schedule.title: Event schedule
body: Browse current and upcoming event timelines.
Use the calendar to check dates and plan stamina or ticket usage.
